text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Ben Ali on Thursday received a report on the results of internal elections held during the previous weeks in preparations for the next congress of the Constitutional Democratic Rallye (RCD, ruling party). Ben Ali, who received RCD's secretary-general Abdelaziz Ben Dhia, also named new chiefs for the party's committees in 12 provinces.

- John Koo, Chairman of South-Korean firm LGF Electronics on Thursday held talks with Tunisian Minister for International Co-operation and Foreign Investment Mohamed Ghannouchi. Koo said his company wants to boost it presence on the Tunisian market.
- Tunisia backs the unity of the Comoros, the foreign affairs ministry said in a statement.
- Finance Minister Mohamed Jeri on Thursday asked a group of accountants to act for better transparency in firms' accounts.
